scripts.install:all: npm install --production=false && cd server && npm install --production=false && cd ../client && npm install --production=false
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.start: node server/dist/server.js || (cd server && npx ts-node --transpile-only src/server.ts)
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:client
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
